titulo.alumno: Introducing a colleague with name, origin and occupation

intro: In this lesson you will practice introducing a colleague with name, origin and occupation.

texto: Locate name, origin and occupation; reuse that information to introduce another person.

frases.alumno: What word do we learn today?

frases.estudio: Αυτή είναι η Μαρία, η νέα μου συνάδελφος. Είναι από τη Λάρισα.
frases.alumno: This is Maria, my new colleague. She is from Larisa.

frases.estudio: Με λένε Άννα, είμαι από την Αθήνα και μιλάω ελληνικά και ισπανικά.
frases.alumno: My name is Anna, I'm from Athens and I speak Greek and Spanish.

frases.estudio: Ο Νίκος είναι από την Πάτρα και δουλεύει σε ξενοδοχείο.
frases.alumno: Nikos is from Patras and works in a hotel.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the introduction and select the personal detail that appears.
